title: Use murex in fusain
description: fusain depends on murex for colour, paths, noise and output instead of copying them from oilpaint.

title: Release murex 0.1.0 on PyPI
description: fusain and oilpaint can only be published depending on murex once murex is on PyPI. Human steps first: pending trusted publisher on PyPI (project murex, owner joce, repo murex, workflow publish.yml, environment pypi) and the pypi environment on GitHub. See RELEASING.md.

title: Move oilpaint onto murex
description: Waits until the work in progress on oilpaint is done. Replace oilpaint's spectral, spline, noise, png, reference and _filters by imports from murex, keeping oilpaint.spectral and the other public names working. Paint becomes a murex Pigment plus body (Paint.mix, from_optics and pickles of older paints need care). oilpaint uses these private names of spectral: _build_spectrum_to_rgb, _km_layer_batch, _layer_over_white, and its tests read _BASIS, _CIE_1931, _CIE_WL, _D65_SPD, _D65_WHITE_XYZ, _RGB_TO_XYZ, _XYZ_TO_LINEAR_SRGB: make public here what oilpaint needs. tools/bench.py --compare must stay identical on all scenes. Needs a murex release on PyPI first.

title: Set up murex with the modules oilpaint and fusain share
description: Scaffolding as in fusain. spectral, spline, noise, png and reference copied from oilpaint main (cd49cd9) as they are; _filters as filters with public names; Pigment is oilpaint's Paint without body.
